newsitem.title: UK: BT adds $500 mln to 6.75 pct five-year bond.
newsitem.headline: BT adds $500 mln to 6.75 pct five-year bond.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc has increased to $1.5 billion from $1.0 billion the size of its 6.75 percent April 2002 Eurobond, joint lead managers Merrill Lynch International and SBC Warburg said on Thursday.
The increase will be priced later at a 12 basis points yield spread over U.S. Treasuries.
The deal was launched on April 8 at a 15 b.p. spread.
